member.name: T:DotNetCore.Collections.Paginable.KeysetPageExtensions
member.summary:
Keyset (seek) pagination extensions.
Offset-based pagination degrades linearly with page number (OFFSET 100000 forces the provider to scan and discard 100000 rows). Keyset pagination avoids both the OFFSET scan and the COUNT(*) round trip: each request is a single WHERE key > @last ORDER BY key LIMIT @size query. Use it for infinite-scroll / cursor APIs; use when you need total page counts.

member.name: T:DotNetCore.Collections.Paginable.KeysetPage`1
member.summary:
Result of a keyset (seek) pagination request.
Unlike offset-based , a keyset page does NOT carry total member/page counts - that is the whole point: no COUNT(*) round trip and no OFFSET scan, so deep pages stay as cheap as shallow ones. The caller chains requests by feeding (of the ordering key) into the next GetPageByKeyset call.
